beats.script:
HOST: A lot of people on GLP-1s are constipated.
GASTROENTEROLOGIST: Yes.
HOST: Is that okay? I mean, what do people need to do about that?
beats.spoken: A lot of people on GLP-1s are constipated. Yes. Is that okay? I mean, what do people need to do about that?
beats.visual: Open on host above female gastroenterologist, equal halves. Both microphones visible; guest listens, then gives the short answer.
beats.edit: Start immediately on the question. Hold the split through “Yes” and the follow-up; retain the natural handoff.
beats.proxy: REFERENCE FRAMING ONLY — cast our female gastroenterologist; source people and show branding are not final assets.

beats.script: GASTROENTEROLOGIST: So there's a couple of things. The GLP-1 drugs naturally slow down the gut.
beats.spoken: So there's a couple of things. The GLP-1 drugs naturally slow down the gut.
beats.visual: Hard cut to guest medium close-up. She gestures naturally as she introduces the two causes.
beats.edit: Cut on the guest’s answer, matching the reference’s first full-screen guest reveal.
beats.proxy: REFERENCE FRAMING ONLY — cast our female gastroenterologist; source people and show branding are not final assets.

beats.script: GASTROENTEROLOGIST: So you get slowed emptying from the stomach
beats.spoken: So you get slowed emptying from the stomach
beats.visual: Translucent torso. Isolate stomach and outlet; a small amount of meal contents moves slowly toward the duodenum.
beats.edit: Straight cut on “slowed emptying.” Guest audio continues. No blocked valve or stool in stomach.
beats.proxy: EXISTING ASSET PROXY — see planned action; not a newly generated shot.

beats.script: GASTROENTEROLOGIST: and you get slowing of the contractions as well. That can cause constipation.
beats.spoken: and you get slowing of the contractions as well. That can cause constipation.
beats.visual: Return guest large; upper-right inset shows spaced, slower contraction waves along a simplified intestinal segment.
beats.edit: Cut back on “contractions”; keep her conclusion visible. Inset disappears when the thought ends.
beats.proxy: REFERENCE FRAMING ONLY — cast our female gastroenterologist; source people and show branding are not final assets.

beats.script: GASTROENTEROLOGIST: The second reason is when you're on a GLP-1, your appetite decreases. And that's one of the benefits that people want.
beats.spoken: The second reason is when you're on a GLP-1, your appetite decreases. And that's one of the benefits that people want.
beats.visual: Guest medium. A small plate icon and a shorter meal indicator appear beside her shoulder as she explains reduced appetite.
beats.edit: Stay on her face for the benefit explanation. Icons enter once, without a sound effect.
beats.proxy: REFERENCE FRAMING ONLY — cast our female gastroenterologist; source people and show branding are not final assets.

beats.script: GASTROENTEROLOGIST: When your appetite decreases, the number one thing which gets cut out first is fiber.
beats.spoken: When your appetite decreases, the number one thing which gets cut out first is fiber.
beats.visual: Guest remains visible. A small top-right illustration shows a smaller meal with fewer fiber-rich foods; remove a vegetable portion, not the whole meal.
beats.edit: Swap the meal icon for the plate illustration exactly on “fiber.” Do not imply every person cuts fiber first.
beats.proxy: REFERENCE FRAMING ONLY — cast our female gastroenterologist; source people and show branding are not final assets.

beats.script: GASTROENTEROLOGIST: So you've got the slowing down of the gut, plus you're less hungry and you cut out fiber.
beats.spoken: So you've got the slowing down of the gut, plus you're less hungry and you cut out fiber.
beats.visual: Listener above, speaking female guest below. Two small labels summarize movement and intake. Reference has a silent male cohost here; use that optional reaction angle if cast, otherwise the main host.
beats.edit: Hard cut to the listening split at the recap. No extra dialogue or exaggerated distress reaction.
beats.proxy: REFERENCE FRAMING ONLY — cast our female gastroenterologist; source people and show branding are not final assets.

beats.spoken: You've got a heady storm where you're brewing some serious constipation.
